subject.title: feat(skills): declarative cron-trigger metadata in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw support autonomous schedule/event execution from SKILL.md metadata, and if so what permission, trust, and audit contract owns it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent product boundary determines whether triggers belong in SKILL.md, ClawHub/plugin manifests, explicit cron jobs, or a permissioned hybrid.

options.title: Design permissioned SKILL.md automation
options.body: Add schedule/event metadata only with explicit operator approval, revocation, last-triggered audit state, and security review of the execution boundary.

options.title: Keep scheduling explicit
options.body: Leave autonomous runs owned by existing cron jobs and require skills to be referenced by explicit operator-managed schedules or standing instructions.

options.title: Move triggers to ClawHub/plugin manifests
options.body: Treat trigger metadata as marketplace or plugin-manifest data first and keep core SKILL.md loading limited until that contract proves sufficient.

recommendation.title: Design permissioned SKILL.md automation
recommendation.body: Add schedule/event metadata only with explicit operator approval, revocation, last-triggered audit state, and security review of the execution boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans public skill docs, skill metadata, cron behavior, and security posture where the history shows adjacent ownership signals.
